newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Isbank ups Q1 net profit 222 pct.
newsitem.headline: Turk Isbank ups Q1 net profit 222 pct.

text.p: Turkiye Is Bankasi (Isbank) raised its net profit by 222 percent to 16.4 trillion lira in the first quarter of 1997, the bank said in a statement.
It said gross profits stood at 25.1 trillion lira, including 5.4 trillion lira of tax provision and 3.3 trillion lira of other provisions.
The bank's equity, including its own capital, revalued funds and reserves, rose by 128 percent to 81.2 trillion lira.

Isbank, one of Turkey's biggest commercial banks, reported a net profit of 38 trillion lira at the end of 1996. It began distributing a total 4.05 trillion lira cash dividend from 1996 profits on April 30.
